description_for_human: Autonomous M365 support triage agent — classify tickets, check customer history, and route to the right agent
description_for_model: Use this plugin to process support tickets through a three-agent pipeline using Work IQ and Fabric IQ. Returns ticket classification, customer history, resolution steps, and escalation decisions.

functions.name: processTicket
functions.description: Process a support ticket through the full TriageAgent → ResolutionAgent → EscalationAgent pipeline

functions.name: getTicketHistory
functions.description: Get all processed tickets with their classification, resolution, and escalation results

functions.name: getCustomerHistory
functions.description: Get the support history and risk profile for a specific customer email

functions.name: getAnalytics
functions.description: Get support operations analytics including deflection rate, SLA compliance, and agent performance
